known.via: English Wikipedia "Somló" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A white wine region on the slopes. Its wines are made from Hárslevelű, Furmint, Juhfark, Welschriesling, Traminer and Chardonnay, mostly from small plots.
